### Ezekiel Condemns the False Prophets
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ezekiel-condemns-false-prophets
Passage: Ezekiel 13:3-4
Points:
- False prophets acted like scavengers during the Babylonian exile, telling people only what they wanted to hear for personal profit.
- Ezekiel labels these messengers foolish because their fabricated visions revealed they had no genuine relationship with God.
- Instead of exposing moral compromise, they masked national sin by whitewashing weak structures and promising peace where none existed.
- Christian leaders today must faithfully guard local congregations by confronting false teaching and preserving gospel truth.
